clues.text: Folk say this town stands on seven hills, just like the town of Rome. The tale links this town to that great town of the past.
clues.narrowing: Puts the player on a plain in south-eastern Europe, on a 'seven hills' city.

source.quote: As with many cities, Bucharest is traditionally considered to be built upon seven hills, similar to the seven hills of Rome.

clues.text: The summers here are hot and damp, with warm wet air for months. The winters here are cold, with snow that falls and stays for weeks.
clues.narrowing: Keeps a continental city: steamy summers, snowy winters.

source.quote: Bucharest has a humid continental climate (Dfa), with hot, humid summers and cold, snowy winters.

clues.text: In 1862, the lands of Wallachia and Moldavia joined as one new land. This town then took the top job as chief town of the whole land.
clues.narrowing: Shrinks the list to capitals created by an 1862 union of two lands.

source.quote: In 1862, after Wallachia and Moldavia were united to form the Principality of Romania, Bucharest became the new nation's capital city.

clues.text: The law house in this town is the most big one of its kind in the world. Both groups of law men meet in its halls, and a great art hall sits there too.
clues.narrowing: Nearly decisive: one capital holds the world's largest parliament building.

source.quote: The largest Parliament building in the world, the palace houses the Romanian Parliament (the Chamber of Deputies, and the Senate), as well as the National Museum of Contemporary Art.

clues.text: Romania is run from this town, where the work of state is done each day. More folk live here than in any other town in the land.
clues.narrowing: Confirms it: capital and largest city of Romania.

source.quote: Bucharest (Romanian: București) is the capital and largest city of Romania.

reveal.blurb: A prince's citadel stood here in 1459, and in 1862 the city became the capital of a newly united country. Its Palace of the Parliament is the largest parliament building on Earth. Bucharest is the capital of Romania.
